summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the closing of a $900 million private placement of equity and pre-funded warrants on June 23, 2026. The company issued ~6.72M shares at $68.73/share and ~6.37M pre-funded warrants at $68.7299 each, exercisable at $0.0001 per share. The warrants include ownership limitations (9.99% initially, increasing to 19.99% after HSR clearance and to 100% after NASDAQ stockholder approval). This is a capital-raise event, not a special-situation transaction like an acquisition or restructuring. Watch for the resale registration statement and stockholder vote to remove the ownership cap.
